import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n = int(data[0])
t = int(data[1])

for i in range(n):
    s, d = map(int, data[2+i*2:4+i*2])
    bus_routes.append((i+1, s, d))

min_time = float('inf')
for route in bus_routes:
    i, s, d = route
    if s >= t:
        wait_time = s - t
    else:
        wait_time = d - ((t - s) % d)
    if wait_time < min_time:
        min_time = wait_time
        best_route = i

print(best_route)

-----Output-----

Print one number — what bus route Serval will use. If there are several possible answers, you can print any of them.
